question: Which of the following is the earliest literary record of Indian culture?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rigveda**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rigveda** is the earliest literary record of Indian culture.
 
• It is one of the four Vedas, which are the oldest sacred texts of Hinduism.
 
• The Rigveda consists of hymns in praise of various deities, mainly composed in Sanskrit.
